During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] of the [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] sub-[[Species/Legends|species]] operated as a '''bounty hunter''' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Clad in a bright [[Color/Legends|orange]] jacket, he wielded two [[434 Deathhammer/Legends|Model 434 blaster pistols]].<ref name="ORH" /> At some point, while accompanied by two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] females, he swindled a pair of beings at cards. They promptly drew [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] on him.<ref name="S">{{FFGTCG|set=Star Wars: The Card Game Core Set|cardname=Swindled}}</ref> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] had grey skin, with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="ORH" />
